subject: Executive sign-off needed: 30% Hosted API concession for LumenHealth
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumenhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing for pilot and ramp — LumenHealth

Hi Jasmine / Ben,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We liked the demo and think Redwood's latency/cost profile could be a good fit for our patient triage workflows. Before we finalize a pilot, we need clarity on pricing for a 3-month pilot and expected ramp to production.

High-level ask: Can Redwood offer us a 30% discount on Hosted API usage pricing for the first 3 months of the pilot, with a commitment for a minimum of 1M tokens during that period and a planned ramp to ~10M tokens/mo by month 6 if the pilot hits our success criteria? We are also evaluating other vendors and pricing will be a gating factor for the POC decision.

Attached is a quick forecast the team asked me to share.

Can you let us know if this is feasible and what approvals are required?

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Platform Partnerships
LumenHealth

Attachments: LumenHealth_MA_Pilot_Usage_Forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

Date: 2027-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for pilot and ramp — LumenHealth

Oliver — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. Really appreciate the volume transparency.

Quick summary of our proposal for the pilot:
- 30% off list Hosted API usage rate for the first 3 months (pilot)
- Commitment: minimum 1M tokens billed across the pilot window (applies to ramp guarantee)
- Post-pilot: pricing reverts to standard volume tiers with discounts applied for committed monthly volumes; we can include a step-down if LumenHealth hits the 10M tokens/mo target by month 6

We can move fast on the pilot if we get executive pricing clearance — internal policy requires >20% concessions to have documented exec signoff and finance review. I've attached an amended concession (proposed_amendment_v2.pdf) and a completed deal desk request (dealdesk_request_form.pdf).

Oliver, is the 1M floor workable? If so, I’ll escalate for sign-off today.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_amendment_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB); dealdesk_request_form.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

Team — forwarding a simple ask from Ben / LumenHealth. They want a one-time 30% concession on Hosted API usage for a 3-month pilot, with a 1M-token minimum. This is above the 20% threshold and requires documented executive/finance approval.

Please see the key points below and the attachments Ben included:
- Customer: LumenHealth (partner evaluation; potential multi-region rollout)
- Ask: 30% off list rate for first 3 months of pilot; 1M tokens minimum
- Strategic rationale: potential to convert to a multi-product account (inference across triage + clinical summarization); short-term revenue sacrifice could drive long-term platform adoption

Requested action: Mina / Marissa — can we get a recommendation for approval? Laura — finance please confirm the tolerance and any required guardrails (SOW wording, minimum term, repayment if churn). If approved, Ben will take the amendment to the customer and we’ll attach the required legal/finance clauses.

I’ve included a suggested set of conditions in the forward (see below). If we can have a decision by end of day tomorrow (Mon 6/20), Ben can keep the momentum with LumenHealth.

Suggested conditions (draft):
- 30% concession limited to Hosted API usage only (no embedding/managed features)
- Applies to first 3 months only; invoice shows concession line-item
- 1M-token minimum USAGE commitment for the pilot window; unused tokens are non-refundable
- If customer cancels before month 3, concession is retroactively reversed and invoiced at full rate for consumed tokens
- Finance to pre-approve billing milestones and required legal language

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
